CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,request_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,sent INTEGER DEFAULT 0,error TEXT DEFAULT '',attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,lock_until INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS limits(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_sessions(token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,expires INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_api_links(product_id TEXT NOT NULL,endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,remote_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(product_id,endpoint),UNIQUE(endpoint,remote_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS product_api_jobs(product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,revision TEXT NOT NULL,error TEXT DEFAULT '',attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,lock_until INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
